policy.optimizer: Take best legally achievable player source value after MAX ranks, attribute hard bound, fully optimized modded gear, compatible enchants Iesnium +1, perfected gems, Supremacy/Malice, max legal Curios and effects. Only then compute Monk final target, subtracting its own legal Curios. Exclude the banned Ring of Seven Deadly Sins.
policy.hard_bound_is_not_build_max: The attribute registration maximum is an engine clamp, not proof that any legal gear/progression combination can reach it. All attainable_gear_plus_skills_max remain null until legal full-build computation or tests.
policy.binary_vs_scalar: Do not apply 85% to Boolean/unlocks, mutually exclusive effects, source-locked biology, combat damage, or capped probabilities already saturated. Compare meaningful outcomes.
